name: Sabina Park
summary: Sabina Park hosts four Jamaica Kingsmen fixtures as the Caribbean Premier League returns to Jamaica in 2026.
tagline: Kingston's storied Test ground returns to the centre of Jamaica's CPL summer.
ends: Blue Mountains End and Headley Stand End
story: Sabina Park is one of Caribbean cricket's great city grounds. Set in Kingston with the Blue Mountains visible beyond the boundary, it has hosted Jamaican first-class cricket since the nineteenth century and West Indies Test cricket since 1930.

That inaugural Test became part of the ground's legend: England opener Andy Sandham made 325, the first triple-century in Test history, while 19-year-old George Headley answered with 223 for West Indies. The large southern stand now carries Headley's name.
CPL cricket returns to Sabina Park in 2026 with four Jamaica Kingsmen home fixtures, restoring a Kingston block to the tournament schedule.

visitor_note: Sabina Park is an active international venue in central Kingston. Match-day access, parking and entry arrangements can change by event, so use CPL's ticket and venue instructions before setting out.
